    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':

    print(m, "->", player_pos(current_frame), last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print("STOP", last_action_result.get('stop_reason'))
        break
</parameter>
